headline: Approved June and July 2026 minutes; discussed patrol staffing, Flock Safety, and the Protect Act.
summary: The group discussed the arrest of a Malden resident and the police department's work with federal law enforcement. Members reviewed a patrol coverage and staffing plan and a follow-up meeting on the Flock Safety Program. The group also discussed the Protect Act and e-bike safety education.
decisions: Approved the June 2026 and July 2026 meeting minutes; the motion was made by Chloe and seconded by Vinnie, and the rest of the council approved.
Confirmed the council will ask the Malden Police Department for information on steps to comply with the Protect Act.

decision_evidence.quote: Group reviewing and approving both June 2026 and July 2026 meeting minutes, Chloe motioning to approve, seconded by Vinnie and approved by rest of council.
Council confirming they will ask for information, Brittany to send along with Q&A document that will be created at conclusion of this meeting.
